title: 2100 Prairie's corner oriel stands on its column
items: The Sherman house's corner at 21st Street now looks like its c. 1890 photograph and the 1876 plate: a stone oriel set across the corner at the second storey, on stepped corbels and a slender stone column with a carved capital, replacing the brick tower that stood from the ground.
Over the oriel's face is its own small coped stone gable with a roundel. Behind it the steep slated pyramid now springs from the main cornice, flared at its foot, instead of from a tower top.
